title: Phearong:
title_q: “What a Single Loan Can Help Do”
headline: Phearong's parents said there was no money for school and she must marry. A Kiva loan through Wedu got her into college; she went on to lead Banteay Srei and help hundreds of women across Cambodia.
story: Vishal tells the story that always stays with him. Phearong wanted to study; her parents said get married. She said no. A loan through Kiva's partner Wedu, funded by lenders on Kiva, got her into college. She did her bachelor's and her master's, came home and became executive director of Banteay Srei, a citadel for women.
The turn is the ripple: one loan changed her life, and then hundreds of women's lives. Kiva sent real photos of Phearong: they replace the old animation.
do: Open on frame 1 with Vishal saying “You know, the story of Phearong…”, hook text on screen.
Use Kiva's photos of Phearong where the plan says. No animation.
Spell her name Phearong, the partner Wedu, the nonprofit Banteay Srei.
Keep the music low the whole way.
End on “…or even a country.” Then the end card.
dont: Do not use phearong-vishal-john-kiva.jpeg: the backdrop is covered in another brand's logos.
Never “investment” on screen. No money graphic: the $2,000 stays in the voice only.
No name plate, logo or fade at 0:00.
No crowded captions and no lime.
